propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable should point to a TOML file that layers its keys over discovered config files rather than replacing them wholesale.
Configuration precedence must be: CLI -c llm.KEY > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > default.
Deep merge of nested tables (leaf key wins) and wholesale array replacement are required, while shallow merge behavior of read_reserved_section must remain unchanged.
The env var must be read as a string literal in os.environ.get("REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE") to enable static documentation generation by scripts/gen_env_registry.py.
A pointer to a nonexistent file must raise a typed rebar config error naming the variable rather than failing silently.
Nested table and array merge semantics must be testable separately from the parent reserved-section machinery.
